title: FLEET-guided observing campaign classifies superluminous supernovae
summary: FLEET used transient light curves and host-galaxy features to prioritize telescope follow-up. Its first two-year campaign spectroscopically classified 21 superluminous supernovae. This is one campaign-level result, not 21 separately counted discoveries or proof that FLEET first detected every object. The result was public in the October 2022 preprint before the 2023 journal article.
organization: Space Telescope Science Institute; Center for Astrophysics | Harvard & Smithsonian

evidence.tested: Spectra supported classifications in the AI-prioritized follow-up sample.
evidence.unknown: First-discovery attribution for individual objects and completeness beyond the studied alerts were not established.
evidence.ai_role: FLEET machine-learning classifier supported the stated study; experimental and interpretive work remained with researchers.

source_review.scope: Primary preprint abstract and submission history; indexed institutional publisher-PDF header and abstract for affiliations and journal chronology.
